description: TRAI-reported 5G FWA subscriptions. Uses source-published All providers regional totals and respects geography and period filters.

expression: VAR CurrentPeriod = MAX(DimPeriod[period_end]) VAR CurrentValue = [5G FWA Subscriptions] VAR PriorPeriod = EOMONTH(CurrentPeriod, -1) VAR PriorValue = CALCULATE([5G FWA Subscriptions], REMOVEFILTERS(DimPeriod), DimPeriod[period_end] = PriorPeriod) RETURN DIVIDE(CurrentValue - PriorValue, PriorValue)
description: Percent change in the selected month-end reported 5G FWA subscription total versus the immediately prior calendar month. First available month is blank.
TRAI-reported wireline subscriber stock. Uses the All providers regional totals and respects geography and period filters.
Number of source observations in the current filter context; not a subscriber KPI.
